title: Obstetric and reproductive medical outcome before / after septal dissection in uterus (sub-) septus
summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate reproductive (e.g., spontaneous onset of pregnancies, miscarriages) and obstetric (e.g., malpositions, preterm births, uterine ruptures) outcomes before and after septal dissection using a specific questionnaire.
conditions: Other congenital malformations of uterus and cervix

interventions.name: All patients which received a septal dissection at the Department of Women's Health or which were presented with uterus (sub) septus. Data collection using patient questionnaires takes place post-operatively (duration: approx. 10 minutes)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- All patients who received a septal dissection at the Department of Women's Health or who were presented with uterine (sub) septus.
- Written consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Age under 18 years
- lack of patient consent
